question: Netanyahu out by end of 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Netanyahu ceases to be prime minister for any period by 12/31/2026 ET, or announces his resignation or removal before then, even if it takes effect later. A new government sworn in under another prime minister counts. Resolves with Polymarket market netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-226-657.
raise_if: Signed coalition agreements with a swearing-in date
lower_if: The mandate passes to a second candidate

history.rationale: 11/07/2026, independent view 28% against the crowd's 36.5%. Two ways this resolves yes. (1) A new government under someone else is sworn in by 12/31: that is the confidence-vote question, which we put at 20%, times about 85% that the new prime minister is not Netanyahu (Eisenkot holds the mandate, fc-il-next-pm-eisenkot), so about 17%. (2) He announces resignation or removal without a new government: the retirement-by-March market is at 17%, and this window is shorter, so about 10%, allowing for the Maariv report of a buy-out offer (ac-netanyahu open questions). Together about 27%; rounded to 28%. The crowd's 36.5% is hard to square with its own 30% on the confidence vote unless it expects a resignation.

players.does: Stays caretaker prime minister and tries to outlast Eisenkot's mandate; resigns only if the trial or a buy-out forces it.
Tries to sign partners before the mandate clock runs out; the swearing-in is the event that removes Netanyahu.
